title: Damped iteration (fictional fixture)
subtitle: A made-up manuscript used to test the review-page tools.
summary_html:
Verdict: short paper or preprint

  • The key step is the block-sum lemma (S4).
  • No fatal finding; one suspected novelty concern.
  • The closest prior work was not read.
intro_html: Convergence of x_{n+1}=(1-h_n)x_n+h_nf(x_n) for a contraction f under a block condition on the steps.
key_ideas_html: The key idea: only block sums of the step sizes matter, so steps may vanish.

S4.evidence: hand check; numeric trial over random step sequences

panel.name: prior-art attacker
panel.result: no overlap in the one read; one unread

findings.short: S3 should state a_n in [0,1] where it is used
findings.detail: The lemma is stated for arbitrary a_n but used only for a_n in [0,1].

findings.short: The block form may already appear in the literature on stochastic approximation
findings.detail: A standard condition in related iterations is stated on block sums; whether it covers this exact statement is unchecked.

review_conclusion: No gap found within the scope shown; one suspected novelty concern remains.
my_checks: Random step sequences with vanishing steps: the product bound held in every trial.

prior.name: Fictional survey A
prior.hyp: needs a tail lower bound on the steps

prior_hole: Fictional article B was not available; novelty of S4 cannot be called strong until it is read.
uncited: A fictional monograph on stochastic approximation (suspected, not checked)
admitted: The paper does not claim the product bound itself.

indicator.verdict_why: No confirmed fatal finding and the difference from the read prior work is stated, but the closest work is unread.
